scope: Original selected-catalogue and source-summary arithmetic audit; no genotype recovery replay
directory_topology_review: All 477 returned folder records checked for unique IDs/paths, known parents and no cycles; three cell-line subtree sizes computed. The topology contains folder names, not a full file inventory.
file_catalogue_review: All 31 direct file records returned for the seven named scopes checked against folder identities; file-content authentication performed only for three small PTA summaries.
exact_summary_review: All six count/frequency records in each of three authenticated small summaries assessed for the denominator convention and Table S2 callability mapping. Original derived aggregates are published; raw six-row summaries remain outside the package.
source_arithmetic_findings: Every frequency equals count divided by non-REF_N count sum within 1e-14
Six reported frequencies sum above one because REF_N uses that same non-REF_N denominator
Two WT and one MSH2KO callability values agree with Table S2 to seven decimal places
The R24 metadata-to-recovery-label reversal is retained
not_demonstrated: Variant-level sensitivity, specificity, precision, or independent genotype truth
Native all-birth inclusion, production per division, transport or biological efficacy
